component.name: Linura
component.summary: The intelligent system layer for Linux

description.p: Linura Control Center is the graphical management client for Linura, presenting observed and desired machine state, intents, plans, approvals, provenance, audit information, explainability, drift, and recovery.

The client communicates through Linura's versioned protocol and remains outside the privileged execution boundary: it contains no distro-specific backend logic and receives no privileged executor handle.
